row: PhysioMassage & Pain Therapy I Life Rx Los Angeles

Welcome to LifeRX 

Move Better. Feel Better. Live Better.

LifeRX is a community built to help you move with less pain, improve your health, strengthen your body, and create a better life through movement, education, and self-growth.
Our channel is built around three powerful programs

🌅 ZARADKA
Your daily morning movement routine.
Wake up your body, improve mobility, increase flexibility, reduce pain, and start every day with energy.

🌙 UNUM DEO
Our evening mind-body practice.
Breathwork, emotional balance, meditation, movement, recovery, and personal growth. A place to reconnect with yourself.

💆 LifeRX Postural Detective Academy
Professional education for massage therapists, bodyworkers, personal trainers, and movement specialists.
Learn assessment, manual therapy, physio massage, postural correction, pain management, business, marketing, and how to build a successful wellness career.

Become a YouTube Member to unlock exclusive classes & live sessions
Join our mission.
